verdict.rationale: The docs repeatedly reference serverless indexes, used for multitenancy and backups, which implies a non-provisioned deployment model. A community comment notes a generous free tier. However, nothing in the evidence documents usage-based billing or published per-unit rates. Missing for 10: documented usage-based pricing model, transparent per-unit cost figures (reads, writes, storage), comparison against provisioned cluster pricing, independent corroboration of billing transparency.
